Camber the Heretic | Camber the Heretic is a fantasy novel by American-born author Katherine Kurtz.  It was first published by Del Rey Books in 1981. While *Survivor's Quest* (2004) is a sequel to *Vision of the Future* (1998), and *Vision of the Future* is part of the *Hand of Thrawn* series which followed the *Heir to the Empire* trilogy, *Vision of the Future* is not accurately described as a "prequel" to *Survivor's Quest* (it is the direct predecessor in publication and chronological order within the main saga). Furthermore, the *Hand of Thrawn* series consists of two novels (*Specter of the Past* and *Vision of the Future*), so identifying a single novel as "the followup" is imprecise, and *Specter of the Past* is the actual first followup to the trilogy, not the book immediately preceding *Survivor's Quest*.
